question: Who among the following has been the longest-serving female chief minister of any Indian state, as on January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**J Jayalalithaa**__.

__
 
• Sheila Dikshit - 15 years, 25 days (Total term) (Delhi - Union Territory)
 
• **J. Jayalalithaa - 14 years, 124 days (Total term) (Tamil Nadu - State)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• J Jayalalithaa -

 
 
• She was an Indian politician and the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.
 
• She was the general secretary of the South Indian political party All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK). ,
 
• After her film career, she started her political career in 1982 with MG Ramachandran.​
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sheila Dixit** was an Indian politician who was the Chief Minister of Delhi (Union Territory not a state) from 1998 to 2013.

 
 
• She was also the Governor of the Indian state of Kerala.
 
• She related to the Indian National Congress Party.
 
 
 
• ** Sucheta Kripalani -**
 
 
• She was an **Indian freedom fighter and politician.**
 
• She became the **Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh **and was **the first woman Chief Minister of India.**
 
• She was the wife of famous Gandhian leader Acharya Kripalani.​
 
 
 
• **Syeda Anwara Taimur -**
 
 
• She is the **leader of the Indian National Congress from Assam.**
 
• She was the** Chief Minister of Assam **from 6 December 1980 to 30 June 1981.
 
• She is the** first Muslim woman chief minister **in the history of Assam and also of independent India.
